units.source_text: 一百几十栋房子全都是一个样式。

en.t: The hundred and several dozen houses were all built in the same style.

units.source_text: 据说，在这里只要依靠总头头的张罗，甚至通缉犯也可以轻而易举地被窝藏起来。

en.t: It was said that here, with only the chief boss making the arrangements, even a wanted criminal could easily be hidden away.

units.source_text: 总头头一按铃，铃声就传遍各家的青楼，给通缉犯报以危险的信号。

en.t: As soon as the chief boss rang the bell, its sound spread through the brothels of every house, warning the wanted criminal of danger.
